title: The Tinker's Toll
objective: Bandits hold the old toll tower above the ford, and a tinker's cart is stuck on the near bank. Clear the road or take what you can, and get back to the shrine alive.

rooms.name: Wayside Shrine
rooms.description: A moss-grown shrine stands where the road dips toward the river. Travellers leave coins here for a safe crossing. The road runs on to a cart pulled up on the verge.

features.name: Offering Bowl
features.description: A shallow stone bowl at the shrine's foot, green with moss.
features.discovery: The bowl is empty but for moss and dead leaves. Someone has taken the offerings, and wet boot prints lead down toward the ford.

rooms.name: Tinker's Cart
rooms.description: A painted cart sits on the verge with its mule unhitched, hung with pots, blades and a dented shield. The road runs on down to the ford.

creatures.name: Merrow the Tinker
creatures.description: A wiry old tinker sits on the cart's tail, sharpening a knife and watching the ford.

topics.name: the tower
topics.reply: "Two bandits took the old toll tower last week. They want a gold piece a wheel to cross, and I haven't got it."

topics.name: the ford
topics.reply: "There's a wolf at the ford, gone thin and bold. A traveller tried to cross three nights back. His shield's still out in the reeds, I'd wager."

rooms.name: Ford
rooms.description: The road runs into a shallow, stony ford, thick with reeds on either bank. A track climbs from the far bank to the toll tower.

features.name: Reeds
features.description: Tall reeds, trampled flat in a ring near the water's edge.
features.discovery: Among the broken reeds lie a traveller's shield, scored by teeth but sound, and a sodden purse.

items.name: Traveller's Shield
items.description: A round wooden shield rimmed with iron, its paint scored by teeth.

items.name: Traveller's Purse
items.description: A sodden leather purse, still holding a few coins.

rooms.name: Toll Tower
rooms.description: A squat stone tower with a chain across the road. A cookfire smokes inside, and a strongbox sits under the stair.

features.name: Strongbox
features.description: An iron-bound box, its lock long since broken.
features.discovery: Inside, wrapped in a rag, is the old toll keeper's seal of office, cast in silver, and beside it a leather purse heavy with the bandits' tolls. Under the purse lie a silver chain and a red stone the bandits took from some traveller.

items.name: Silver Toll Seal
items.description: A heavy silver seal stamped with the old toll keeper's mark.

items.name: Bandit's Purse
items.description: A leather purse heavy with the bandits' tolls.

items.name: Silver Toll Chain
items.description: The toll keeper's chain of office, fine silver links gone dark with neglect.

items.name: Traveller's Carnelian
items.description: A smooth orange-red carnelian, polished by someone's thumb.

passages.description: The road runs a short way down to the cart.
The road slopes down through the reeds to the water.
A rutted track climbs from the far bank to the tower.

opponents.description: A gaunt grey wolf rises out of the reeds, hackles up, and comes at you through the shallows.

opponents.name: Scarred Bandit
opponents.description: A scarred bandit kicks over a stool and draws a scimitar.

opponents.name: Young Bandit
opponents.description: A young bandit scrambles down the stair, blade in hand.

endings.title: Back with the takings
endings.text: You climb back to the shrine with the road's takings in your pack, and the river murmuring behind you.

endings.title: Back empty-handed
endings.text: You climb back to the shrine with nothing to show for the road but wet boots.

endings.title: Lost on the road
endings.text: You fall by the river. Your adventuring ends here.
